It is often used to describe the intellectual or spiritual illumination that comes from knowledge and wisdom. Parents who choose Rubay usually hope their child will grow to embody light, brightness, knowledge and live with faith, good character and purpose.

In the Quran, Allah is described as the "Light of the Heavens and the Earth," emphasizing the importance of light in understanding the divine and guiding humanity. Rubay, as a name that signifies light, serves as a constant reminder of the spiritual journey towards the Divine. It motivates individuals to seek knowledge, wisdom, and to be a source of guidance and enlightenment to others, ultimately drawing them closer to Allah.
